network.prose: PostgreSQL database with the core schema of personal-finance (Laravel migrations) (the formal lists the core tables and their stable columns, primary and unique keys and foreign keys between them). Every personal-finance instance that uses the same cluster key and the same schema shares this database.

formal.db.table.ajustes: id:uuid; clave:character varying(255); valor:jsonb null | pk(id) | uq(clave)
formal.db.table.auditorias: id:uuid; evento:character varying(255); auditable_type:character varying(255) null; auditable_id:character varying(64) null; created_at:timestamp(0) without time zone null | pk(id)
formal.db.table.categories: id:uuid; name:character varying(100); parent_id:uuid null | pk(id) | uq(name) | fk(parent_id->categories.id del=set null upd=no action)
formal.db.table.establishments: id:uuid; name:character varying(255); category_id:uuid null | pk(id) | uq(name) | fk(category_id->categories.id del=set null upd=no action)
formal.db.table.expense_items: id:uuid; expense_id:uuid; category_id:uuid null; concept:character varying(255) null; quantity:numeric(10,3) default='1'::numeric; unit_price:numeric(10,2) | pk(id) | fk(category_id->categories.id del=set null upd=no action) | fk(expense_id->expenses.id del=cascade upd=no action)
formal.db.table.expenses: id:uuid; establishment_id:uuid null; date:timestamp(0) with time zone; total:numeric(10,2) null; status:character varying(16) default='PAID'::character varying | pk(id) | fk(establishment_id->establishments.id del=set null upd=no action)
formal.db.table.users: id:uuid; name:character varying(255); email:character varying(255) | pk(id) | uq(email)
